records.text: A former Mossad agent said Mossad could create foreign shell companies with no trace back to Israel and use them to influence supply chains.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep IqHsl7d2dos)

appearances.snippet: We have an incredible array of possibilities of creating foreign companies that have in no way been traced back to Israel, shell companies over shell companies who affect the supply chain to our favor.

verification.notes: The CBS 60 Minutes transcript records a masked retired Mossad officer using the alias Michael saying Mossad could create foreign companies untraceable to Israel and layer shell companies to influence the supply chain. This verifies the attributed statement.

sources.title: Inside Israels Plot to Deliver Explosive Pagers to Hezbollah — 60 Minutes Transcript
sources.relevance: CBS transcript contains the retired Mossad officers description of untraceable foreign and shell companies affecting supply chains.

records.text: A former Mossad agent described Mossad as creating a pretend world in which it writes the screenplay and acts as director, producer, and principal actor.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep IqHsl7d2dos)

appearances.snippet: We create a pretend world. We are a global production company. We write the screenplay. We're the directors, we're the producers, we're the main actors. ... The world is our state.

verification.notes: The CBS 60 Minutes transcript records retired Mossad officer Michael describing a pretend world and saying the agency was a global production company that wrote the screenplay and served as directors, producers, and main actors. This verifies the attributed statement.

sources.title: Inside Israels Plot to Deliver Explosive Pagers to Hezbollah — 60 Minutes Transcript
